scope: Five deliberately selected PDF extraction-quality checks by one Hindi reader, not a probability sample or answer/claim labels
timer_limitations: Browser-visible time can include idle time; not a verified focused-work duration
pilot_and_buffer_accounting: Charge recorded time to the ten-minute pilot and then its five-minute buffer; keep the total PDF review cap at ninety minutes
notes: Damaged Unicode pages may contain usable spans. Whole-page readability does not certify exact evidence or justify automatic release. Raw notes and source pages remain private.
